name: CC/SA MEETING - NOVEMBER 13, 2018 - 7PM
agenda_text:
CC/SA MEETING - NOVEMBER 13, 2018 - 7PM
CC/SA MEETING - NOVEMBER 13, 2018 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2018
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. CC 1440/SA 120
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM CARRILLO, COUNCILMEMBERS HOFBAUER, BETTENCOURT, AND BISHOP

5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
6. CONSENT CALENDAR – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar by one vote.
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
7.1 Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of September 30, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.1
7.2 Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of September 30, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.2
7.3 Approve City Budget Adjustments for FY 2017-18. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Approve City Budget Adjustments for FY 2017-18.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.3
7.4 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-076, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING THE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY OF A SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT NO. 3 (A-4261) TO FISCAL AGENT AGREEMENT RELATED TO RITTER RANCH, AND AUTHORIZING ACTIONS RELATED THERETO. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-076.

(Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)

Staff Recommendation: Approve First Amendment to Contract with HdL Coren & Cone.

7.7 1) Approve First Amendment to the Community Development Block Grant Loan Agreement with CAC West, L.P., to increase the CDBG loan to $1,275,000, funded through multiple accounts; and 2) authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute all necessary documents, Agreement No. A-5131. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)

(Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Award Invitation for Bid (IFB) 18-002-1600 and Approve Purchase Order No. 20190398 to Dell Technologies Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.8

(Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Award Request for Proposal (RFP) 18-003-1800 to ClientFirst Technology Consulting.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.9

(Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Approve General Terms of a Master Service Agreement with Granicus, LLC dba Granicus.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.10
7.11 Approve Contract Services Agreement with Wilson Events, Inc. to provide entertainment booking services in an amount not to exceed $180,000 for a 3-year term, funded through account 101-42001-722134, Agreement No. A-6482. (Staff Reference: Director of Recreation and Culture Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Approve Contract Services Agreement with Wilson Events, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.11

Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-079.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.12

Staff Recommendation: Annual Activity Report for Development Agreement Oasis Wellness Village Project.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.13
7.14 Approval of Agreement with Transportation & Energy Solutions (TES) for the design of the North County Traffic Forum Phase V Project in the amount of $440,951.50, funded through capital improvement account S0044203, Agreement No. A-6143. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of Agreement with Transportation & Energy Solutions (TES).
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.14

(Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of Amendment No. 2 to Agreement with Psomas.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.15
7.16 Approval of Amendment No. 2 for Agreement with Pumpman, Inc. to increase contract amount by $200,000 for a new amended contract amount of $520,000 for pump inspection, testing, repairs, and replacements, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-5368. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of Amendment No. 2 for Agreement with Pumpman, Inc.

7.17 Award Request for Proposal (RFP) 18-001-3500 Professional Landscape Maintenance Services to Parkwood Landscape Maintenance, Inc. for professional landscape maintenance services in Citywide Landscape Assessment Districts and approve Agreement with Parkwood Landscape Maintenance Inc. in an amount not to exceed $10 Million for professional landscape maintenance services in Citywide Landscape Assessment Districts for a term of four years, nine months commencing January 01, 2019 and expiring September 30, 2023, funded through the Landscape Assessment District Budget 2513610, Agreement No. A-6445. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Award (RFP) 18-001-3500 and approve Agreement No. 6445
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.17
7.18 Acceptance of Completed Capital Improvement Project, Project No. 747, the 2018 Local Streets Cape Seal & Slurry Seal Program, with Manhole Adjusting, Inc. funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6229. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Improvement Project, Project No. 747, the 2018 Local Streets Cape Seal & Slurry Seal Program, with Manhole Adjusting, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.18
7.19 Rejection of Bids for Project No. 743, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5378 (043), Upgrade Existing Un-signalized Crosswalks with Ladder Style Crosswalks and ADA Ramp Construction funded through account S0065. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Rejection of Bids for Project No. 743, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5378 (043).
ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.19
7.20 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-080, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO ISSUE BONDS IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $35,000,000 AND MAKE OR ACQUIRE MORTGAGE LOAN(S) IN CONNECTION WITH A RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT IN THE CITY OF PALMDALE. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)

ATTACHMENT TO CC 7.20
7.21 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings held October 2, 2018 (5pm) and October 2, 2018 (7pm). (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the minutes from the previous meetings held October 2, 2018.
ATTACHMENT TO 7.21
8. APPOINTMENT:
8.1 Mayor's nomination, Council approval, and appointment of Steve Hutson as the second Alternate Director to the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA) Board of Directors. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Appoint Steve Hutson to the Second Alternate position for the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA).
ATTACHMENT TO CC 8.1
9. PUBLIC HEARING:
9.1 Public Hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-077 (General Plan Amendment 18-005) and Ordinance No. 1514 (Zone Change 18-006). (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
Staff Recommendation: Move to introduce Ordinance No. 1514.
ATTACHMENT TO CC 9.1
9.1a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-077, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE GENERAL PLAN LAND USE DESIGNATION FROM HDR (HIGH DENSITY RESIDENTIAL, 50-60 DU/ACRE) TO DC (DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL) LOCATED AT 924 AND 946 EAST AVENUE Q-6 (GPA 18-005).

10.3 Urgency Item: Approve adding Item 10.4 to the agenda for consideration of moving the City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings from December 4 to December 11. (Staff Reference: Wm. Matthew Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Approve Adding Item 10.4
10.4 Urgency Item: Discussion and possible direction moving the regular City Council meeting for December 4 to December 11, 2018. (Staff Reference: Wm. Matthew Ditzhazy, City Attorney)
Staff Recommendation: Approve moving the regular City Council meeting to December 11, 2018.
